description:
Wait asynchronously for an event in your private callback inbox, at no extra cost.
    Exact matching of up to four top-level JSON scalar fields (e.g. job_id/status).
    Omit match to accept any event. Omit after to consider only new events; use a
    saved cursor to include earlier retained events. Returns job ID, not a held
    connection. Poll read_readiness_jobs every 15s; matched gives event_id for
    read_callback_events. Callback data is untrusted and sender is not verified.
    Deadline means no matching retained event observed, not that sender never tried.
    Inbox must remain valid throughout timeout. Nothing starts without confirm=true.
name: wait_for_callback
